definitions.gloss: cold treatment; inhospitable reception; being treated poorly
definitions.explanation: Being treated coldly or unfavorably, especially in a professional or social setting. The opposite of preferential or warm treatment.

examples.japanese: {冷遇|れいぐう}されて{悲|かな}しかった。
examples.english: I was saddened by the cold treatment.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}{後|ご}、{前|まえ}の{会社|かいしゃ}で{冷遇|れいぐう}されていたと{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: After changing jobs, I realized I had been treated poorly at my previous company.

examples.japanese: {功績|こうせき}があるにもかかわらず{冷遇|れいぐう}されている{社員|しゃいん}が{少|すく}なくない。
examples.english: There are quite a few employees who are treated poorly despite their achievements.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a noun and as a suru-verb ({冷遇|れいぐう}する). The opposite is {厚遇|こうぐう} (generous treatment) or {優遇|ゆうぐう} (preferential treatment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷遇|れいぐう}する (to treat coldly)
- {冷遇|れいぐう}される (to be treated coldly)
- {冷遇|れいぐう}を{受|う}ける (to receive cold treatment)
